non_negotiable_rules: Sample size never proves legality, permission, provenance or market representativeness.
Critical rights, provenance, identity and terminal-state defects have zero tolerance; statistical allowance applies only to pre-declared non-critical defects.
Every admitted event must pass the rights and schema census; unknown, expired, revoked or mismatched evidence is HOLD.
Canary, adapter reliability, private E2E, beta reliability and production SLO are separate claims and separate gates.
Sampling plan, endpoint, tolerance, confidence and stopping rule are sealed before observation.
Duplicates, retries, parse drops and timeouts cannot inflate the denominator or success count.
A source owner is an ultimate legal owner; brand aliases do not create independence.
Coverage, diversity, territory, currency, time and vertical claims require their own strata gate.
Public, Production, G5, provider contact, spend, credentials and legal commitments remain separate approvals.

track_alignment.KPMO: Own policy versioning, cross-track digest binding, exception register and escalation; cannot waive statistical or rights gates.
track_alignment.TRACK_A: Pre-register population, sampling frame, strata and claim ceiling; produce evidence and sample decision receipt; never convert n into market claim.
track_alignment.TRACK_B: Independently recompute exact confidence bounds, cluster/effective n, strata and stopping decision; reject post-hoc plans and pooled masking.
track_alignment.TRACK_C: Render only approved Projection and claim ceiling; expose tier, scope and HOLD state; never infer readiness from record count.
track_alignment.TRACK_D: Bind admitted cohort dynamically to PostgreSQL/PITR receipts; measure natural run SLO and error budget, not event-count proxies.
track_alignment.TRACK_E: Consume read-only approved metrics with policy version, uncertainty and claim ceiling; no executive override of evidence.
track_alignment.TRACK_Z: Negotiate adaptive volume bands and rights purpose schedules; no contract or price is implied by a fixed 120 quantity.
track_alignment.ASI: Apply census rights gate first, then claim-specific sample policy and source/vertical coverage gates; all unresolved external evidence remains HOLD.
